about: The scripted fallback's own sentences for the analysis board (COACH §7, feature A11): what is said when the coach is off, down, or was refused twice. Everything about the position itself comes from the fact packet, word for word; these are only the questions and nudges of the hint ladder. {role} and {square} are filled from a fact; {square} becomes a square the owner can click.
hint.question.threat: What does their last move attack? Look at what they could capture or check next.
hint.question.loose: Is any of their pieces unprotected?
hint.question.routine: Run the routine: what are your checks, captures and threats here?
hint.nudge.danger: One of your pieces or pawns is in danger. Check every capture they have.
hint.nudge.improve: Look for a move that attacks something or improves your worst-placed piece.
hint.arrow: The arrow shows where to look.
hint.captures: Check each of their captures in turn.
quiet: No piece can be taken for free and there is no immediate threat.
